findings.fix: Define pinVectorAction / pinToOrthogonal Q : pinGroup Q →* QuadraticMap.orthogonalGroup Q with the same proof, then set spinToOrthogonal Q := (pinToOrthogonal Q).comp (Submonoid.inclusion inf_le_left) using spinGroup Q ≤ pinGroup Q (spinGroup = pinGroup ⊓ even, so inf_le_left). This also matches the roadmap item 'The Pin and Spin groups and the double covers'.
findings.issue: Under-generalized. Every ingredient of the proof exists verbatim at the pinGroup level (pinGroup.toUnits, pinGroup.conjAct_smul_range_ι, pinGroup.star_mul_self_of_mem, pinGroup.mul_star_self_of_mem, pinGroup.star_eq_inv, Group (pinGroup Q)); nothing uses evenness. The result also lands in O(Q), not SO(Q) — the PR explicitly does not prove det = 1 — so there is no spin-specific content. The natural target is the Pin representation pinGroup Q →* O(Q).

summary: The action is proved only for spinGroup, but the entire proof is spin-agnostic — it lands in O(Q) (not SO(Q)) and uses only pinGroup-level facts. It should be stated for pinGroup and the spin version derived by restriction.
